articles.author: Ben Berkowitz
articles.title: Musk pledges 1 SpaceX share for every child in America - Axios
articles.description: At current market prices it'd be a gift worth nearly $11 billion.
articles.content:
What they're saying: "Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many," Musk said in a post to X just before 4 a.m. ET Monday.
